findings.description: 猜疑心の強い is rendered extremely jealous, recurring for paranoia about assassination and aftermath of failed cult relief.

contexts.japanese:
その莫大な財産は、老獪で狡猾で猜疑心の強い絵羽の手元にあってはどうしようもないが、
……小娘に過ぎない縁寿に相続されれば、自在に掠め取れるのではないかと目論む者たちがいると噂される。
今や、金蔵の子孫たちは絵羽と縁寿の２人だけ。
……絵羽が死ねば全ての財産は縁寿に相続される。
…そしてさらに縁寿まで殺されることがあれば、
……その財産は、縁寿の母である霧江の実家に相続される。
その意味においては、絵羽だけでなく縁寿もまた、
…正体不明の何者かにいつ命を狙われてもおかしくない立場にいた。
……そして絵羽は、縁寿を長く憎んでいた。
大切な一人息子の譲治を失い、
……自分の財産の相続人が、１２年前のあの日、
親族会議を欠席して生き残った彼女だけだということを知ったからだ。
絵羽は縁寿を疎み、嫌い、そして憎悪さえした。
彼女を特別な学校へ隔離し、人並みの幸福や青春から遠ざけ、生涯を飼い殺すつもりであった。
……しかし、絵羽は不治の病を患い、
その余命は皮肉にも、…１２年前の親族会議で、金蔵に宣告されていたのと同じものになっていた…。
絵羽も縁寿も、…互いを憎しみあっている。
最後の肉親同士だというのに、…早く相手が死ねばいいのにと、憎しみあっている…。
「………それで？
わざわざ呼び付けて何の用…？」
「……私はもう長くないわ。
……藪医者どもは、未だに私が盛られた毒が何かも検出できない。
………わかってるの。
きっと某国の諜報機関で使われてた秘密の暗殺薬なのよ」
「…あぁ、私は殺されるのよ、殺されるのよ…！！
良かったわね、もうじき死ぬわよ、そうすればさぞやあなたの胸がすくでしょうねぇ…！」
「……………………………。
…可哀想な人」
いつものことだ。
……本題からすぐに逸脱して、物騒な話に捻じ曲がる。
猜疑心で肥大化した絵羽は、自身が常に命を狙われていると信じていた。

contexts.WH: It couldn't be helped that this vast wealth would fall into the cunning, sly, and extremely jealous Eva's hands, ......but it was rumored that if it passed on to Ange, who was no more than a young girl, certain people were plotting to snatch it away at once.
contexts.MG:
While this vast wealth lay in Eva's cunning, sly, and suspicious hands, no one was able to complain,
...but it was rumored that as soon as it was passed on to Ange, who was no more than a young girl, certain people were plotting to snatch it away.
By now, Eva and Ange were Kinzo's only descendants.
...If Eva died, all of the wealth would go to Ange.
...And if Ange were then to be killed as well,
...that wealth would go to the family of Ange's mother, Kyrie.
In this sense, not only Eva, but Ange as well,
...were in a position where it wouldn't be odd at all for their life to be targeted by some unknown person.
...And Eva had hated Ange for a long time.
This was because she knew that, after losing her only precious son, George,
...the inheritor of her own wealth would be none other than the girl who had been absent at that family conference 12 years ago,
and who had survived.
Eva shunned Ange, disliked her, and even hated her.
She isolated Ange in a special school and separated her from the youth and happiness normal people have, trying to keep her as a pet until death.
...However, Eva had succumbed to an incurable illness,
and ironically, ...her remaining life was estimated to be the same as Kinzo's had been at that family conference 12 years ago.
Both Eva and Ange...hated each other.
Even though they were each other's last blood relatives, ...they hated each other so much that they hoped the other would die quickly...
"......And?
Why did you go to all the trouble of calling for me...?"
"...I don't have much time left.
...These quack doctors still can't detect any of the poison that's filling me up.
......I know.
I'm sure it's some secret assassination drug used by those Soviet KGBs.
...Ooh, I'm gonna be killed, I'm gonna be killed...!!
Isn't that great?! Very soon, I will die, which will surely be quite a load off your back...!"
"............
...What a pitiable person."
This always happened.
...They immediately deviated from the main topic, distorting it into a more unsettling discussion.
Eva, who was absolutely paranoid, believed that someone was always after her life.
contexts.UP:
They could do nothing while this vast wealth was in the hands of the cunning, sly, and extremely suspicious Eva,
......but it was rumored that if it passed on to Ange, who was no more than a young girl, certain people were plotting to snatch it away at once.
By now, Eva and Ange were Kinzo's only descendants.
......If Eva died, all of the wealth would go to Ange.
...And if Ange were to be killed as well,
......that wealth would go to the family of Ange's mother, Kyrie.
In this sense, not only Eva, but Ange as well,
...was in a position where it wouldn't be odd at all for her life to be targeted by some unknown person.
......And Eva had hated Ange for a long time.
Because, after losing her precious only son George,
......she had learned that the only one who had survived to inherit her own wealth...
was Ange, who had been absent from that family conference twelve years ago.
Eva shunned Ange, hated her, even detested her.
She isolated Ange in a special school, and separated her from the youth and happiness normal people have, trying to deprive her life of all opportunity.
......However, Eva had succumbed to an incurable illness,
and ironically, ...her remaining life was estimated to be the same as Kinzo's had been at that family conference twelve years earlier...
Both Eva and Ange...hated each other.
Even though they were each other's last blood relatives, ...they hated each other so much that they hoped the other would die quickly...
".........And?
Why did you go to all the trouble of calling for me...?"
"......I don't have much time left.
......These quack doctors still have no idea what I was poisoned with.
.........But I know.
I'm sure it's that secret assassination drug, the one that foreign intelligence agency was using."
"...Ooh, I'm going to be killed, I'm going to be killed...!!
Aren't you lucky, very soon, I will die, and then you will be so relieved...!"
".................................
...What a pitiable person."
This always happened.
......She immediately deviated from the main topic, distorting it into a more unsettling discussion.
Eva, who was full of suspicion, believed that someone was always after her life.
contexts.note: Both restore suspicion and paranoia at the two occurrences.

contexts.MG: and if anything, they ended up increasing her paranoia further...
contexts.UP: and only further increased her suspicion...
contexts.note: Third recurrence also restores paranoia or suspicion.

findings.sourceReading: Eva is cunning and highly suspicious; distrust supports guarded wealth, assassination beliefs and increased distrust after cult approaches.
findings.alternative: She also envies Ange survival, but 猜疑心 here is suspicious distrust, not envy or possessive jealousy.

findings.sourceReading: Predators can do nothing with the fortune while shrewd Eva controls it, but hope they can freely skim it once young Ange inherits.
findings.alternative: It could not be helped can loosely suggest difficulty, but English makes wealth falling to Eva inevitable rather than saying others cannot touch it in her hands.

findings.description: 教祖たちをずいぶん招き入れた becomes searched for the founders.

contexts.japanese: 絵羽は一時期、心の安寧を求めたのか、おかしな新興宗教の教祖たちをずいぶん招き入れた。
contexts.japanesePC: 絵羽は一時期、心の安寧を求めたのか、おかしな新興宗教の教祖たちをずいぶん招き入れた。
contexts.japanesePS3: 絵羽は一時期、心の安寧を求めたのか、おかしな新興宗教の教祖たちをずいぶん招き入れた。
contexts.WH: For a time, Eva had searched for the founders of several strange and new religious cults, perhaps looking for peace in her heart.
contexts.MG: For a time, Eva had searched for the founders of several strange and new religious cults, perhaps seeking peace in her heart.
contexts.UP: For a time, Eva had invited in the founders of several strange new religious cults, perhaps looking for peace in her heart.
contexts.note: MG searches for cult founders; UP restores inviting them in.

findings.sourceReading: Eva invited numerous leaders of strange new religions into her circle, perhaps seeking peace, but they failed to relieve her.
findings.alternative: Search could precede invitation, and preceding dialogue reports their advice, but the source explicitly asserts she admitted/invited them rather than merely sought them.

findings.description: わかんないわ。馬鹿だから becomes I do not get it. Because it is stupid.

contexts.japanese:
「……わかんないわ。
馬鹿だから」
contexts.japanesePC: 「……わかんないわ。馬鹿だから。」
contexts.japanesePS3:
「……わかんないわ。
馬鹿だから」
contexts.WH: "......I don't get it.  Because it's stupid."
contexts.MG:
"...I don't get it.
Because it's stupid."
contexts.UP:
"......No idea.
Because I'm stupid."
contexts.note: MG calls it stupid; UP restores the speaker’s self-description.

findings.sourceReading: Ange says she does not understand because she is stupid, sarcastically echoing the contemptuous family framing.
findings.alternative: English preserves dismissiveness but directs the insult at the proposition rather than performing self-deprecation toward her aunt.

findings.description: 自分はここから一歩も動いていない becomes she would not move a step from where she was.

contexts.japanese: 縁寿はじろりとそれを見て、無言で、自分はここから一歩も動いていないとアピールする。
contexts.japanesePC: 縁寿はじろりとそれを見て、無言で、自分はここから一歩も動いていないとアピールする。
contexts.japanesePS3: 縁寿はじろりとそれを見て、無言で、自分はここから一歩も動いていないとアピールする。
contexts.WH: Ange glanced at him, wordlessly showing that she wouldn't move a step from where she was.
contexts.MG: Ange glanced at him, wordlessly making it clear that she didn't intend to move a step from where she was.
contexts.UP: Ange glanced at him, wordlessly showing that she hadn't moved a step from where she had been.
contexts.note: MG gives future intention not to move; UP restores not having moved.

findings.sourceReading: Ange silently signals that she has not moved, preempting any accusation she caused Eva's coughing or death.
findings.alternative: Staying still can imply no involvement, but English makes her signal prospective rather than presenting her past nonmovement as evidence.

findings.description: 誰にも心を許さず ... 誰も愛さず becomes No one trusted her ... No one loved her, with added so causal links.

contexts.japanese:
…誰にも心を許さず、信じようとしない。
誰も愛さず、愛そうとしない。
contexts.japanesePC:
…誰にも心を許さず、信じようとしない。
誰も愛さず、愛そうとしない。
contexts.japanesePS3:
…誰にも心を許さず、信じようとしない。
誰も愛さず、愛そうとしない。
contexts.WH:
...No one trusted her, so she didn't even try to believe them.
No one loved her, so she didn't even try to love.
contexts.MG:
...No one trusted her, so she never bothered to believe in anyone.
No one loved her, so she never even tried to love.
contexts.UP:
...She trusted no one, and didn't even try.
She loved no one, and didn't even try.
contexts.note: MG reverses who trusts and loves whom and adds causal links; UP restores Ange’s agency.

findings.sourceReading: Ange lets nobody into her heart, refuses to trust, loves nobody and refuses to try loving, after her environment has shaped her.
findings.alternative: Surrounding ostracism supports social rejection, but these clauses explicitly describe her own withdrawn dispositions, not universal absence of others' love/trust or a new causal statement.

findings.description: 魔女の娘は魔女 becomes the witch girl was a witch, losing the daughter relation.

contexts.japanese: 魔女の娘は魔女だと、誰もが囁く。
contexts.japanesePC: 魔女の娘は魔女だと、誰もが囁く。
contexts.japanesePS3: 魔女の娘は魔女だと、誰もが囁く。
contexts.WH: Everyone whispered that the witch girl was a witch.
contexts.MG: Everyone whispered that the daughters of witches are witches too.
contexts.UP: Everyone whispered that the daughter of a witch was a witch.
contexts.note: Both restore the witch’s daughter relation.

findings.sourceReading: Everyone says the witch's daughter is a witch, extending Eva's public stigma to her ward as a daughter.
findings.alternative: Girl retains youth and accusation, but cannot preserve inherited stigma through the supposed mother/daughter link, explicitly quoted daughter earlier.

contexts.japanese: …縁寿には、その見えない星明りの中にこそ、自分が本当に求めるものがあるように思えてならない。
contexts.japanesePC: …縁寿には、その見えない星明りの中にこそ、自分が本当に求めるものがあるように思えてならない。

contexts.WH: ...Ange couldn't really imagine that the thing she really sought could be in that unseen starlight.
contexts.MG: ...Ange couldn't help but think that what she truly sought must lie in that unseen starlight.
contexts.UP: ...Ange couldn't help but think that what she really sought lay somewhere in that unseen starlight.
contexts.note: Both restore the irresistible affirmative feeling about unseen starlight.

findings.sourceReading: Ange cannot help feeling that precisely within the unseen starlight lies what she truly seeks.
findings.alternative: The stars cannot be seen, but the source distinction is between visible absence and inward certainty; English denies the inward possibility instead.

………あとちょっとで届きそうなのに、それさえも届かない。

さらに力強く手を伸ばそうと、夢の中で無駄な努力を繰り返すのだ。
せめて戦人兄さんだけでも、生きていてくれたなら。
………私はこの冷たく寂しい現実を、せめて二人で支えあいながら生きていけるのではないか。
でも、その手はいつも、届かない。
